title: sutra_impact + sutra_orient lesson injection
description:
## Parent

sutra/150 — Code-anchored lessons: sutra_remember / contextual surfacing

## What to build

Extend contextual lesson surfacing to `sutra_impact` and `sutra_orient`, completing all three surfacing channels.

**sutra_impact**: The tool already resolves the target symbol, its file, and affected files. Build a `MatchContext` from the target symbol + file + imports, query matching lessons, include as a `lessons` array in the response (positioned as warnings about the blast radius area).

**sutra_orient**: Inside the `for comp in &components` loop, build a `MatchContext` from the component's files and component ID, query matching lessons, add a `lessons` array to each component section alongside conventions.

Both use the same `LessonsDb::query_for_context()` from sutra/151 — this slice is pure glue.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `sutra_impact` response includes matching lessons for the target symbol
- [ ] `sutra_orient` response includes matching lessons per component section
- [ ] Lessons appear alongside conventions in orient output (not in a separate top-level section)
- [ ] No regression in impact/orient responses when no lessons match
- [ ] Tests: lessons surface in impact, lessons surface in orient per-component

## Blocked by

- sutra/152 — 5x-review-1
